source_identification: UCLA Basic Qual, Winter 2012, containing twelve numbered problems; candidates are instructed to submit any ten, with at least four from Problems 1–6 and four from Problems 7–12.
deterministic_extraction_limit: The fresh MinerU Flash output is not byte-identical to the retained unknown-provenance extraction and is locally noisier. It loses several map/convergence arrows, garbles the partial-sum index in Problem 4, and still garbles the displayed matrix in Problem 11. Existing source-checked cards record source-faithful repairs, including the Problem 11 matrix [[1,3],[4,2]]. The source itself also has a Hausdorff-distance empty-set issue in Problem 1 and an unused parameter k in Problem 7, both recorded on cards. No fallback extraction or independent full-source transcription was used.
card_reconciliation: The current shared SRC-UCLA-BASIC-WINTER-2012 collection represents all twelve source positions in order with twelve source-local cards. Several collection paths have unrelated live formatting edits in the shared tree; this intake does not modify or stage any of them.
